PUBLIC COMMENTS
The public is encouraged to address the City Council or any of its Agencies listed on this agenda on any matter posted on the agenda or on any other matter within its jurisdiction. If you wish to address the City Council or any of its Agencies, you may do so during the PUBLIC COMMUNICATIONS period noted on the agenda. Each person is allowed three (3) minutes speaking time. A Spanish speaking interpreter is available for your convenience.
COMENTARIOS DEL PUBLICO
Se invita al público a dirigirse al Concilio o cualquiera otra de sus Agencias nombradas en esta agenda, para hablar sobre cualquier asunto publicado en la agenda o cualquier tema que esté bajo su jurisdicción. Si usted desea la oportunidad de dirigirse al Concilio o alguna de sus Agencias, podrá hacerlo durante el período de Comentarios del Público (Public Communications) anunciado en la agenda. A cada persona se le permite hablar por tres (3) minutos. Hay un intérprete para su conveniencia.

1.
REVIEW AND APPROVAL OF THE CITY OF BALDWIN PARK CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PLAN TO IMPROVE CITY STREETS, FACILITIES AND TRAFFIC SAFETY IN THE COMMUNITY
Staff recommends City Council:
1) authorize staff to complete a bid package and advertise for construction bids the proposed street improvements consisting of overlays, chip seals and slurry seals estimated to cost $4,136,000, except advertisement of bids for the Ramona project, would be done upon receipt of clearance from CalTrans;
2) authorize staff to prepare bid packages and proceed with completing priority street repairs per Attachment C of the staff report estimated to cost $250,000;
3) authorize staff to prepare procurement documents to implement the proposed Traffic Safety Enhancements included in Attachment D of the staff report estimated at $382,000. $160,000 of these improvements (6 speed feed back signs and Francisquito Avenue signal enhancements) to be procured through a change order under recommendation 7;
4) authorize staff to set aside funds for the Walkability Program in the amount of $200,000;
5) authorize the Finance Director to allocate Proposition C Funds for the design and construction of the Transit Center Parking Facility in the amount of $2,500,000;
6) authorize staff to prepare the bid package and advertise for construction bids the second phase of the Morgan Park improvements using already approved budgeted funds; and
7) authorize staff to approve a change order for the Francisquito Rehabilitation contractor, Hardy and Harper in the amount of $250,000, to include Traffic Safety Enhancements (signal enhancements $91,000; speed feed back signs $69,000) and urgent street repairs in the amount of $90,000 per Attachment B of the staff report.
